errors.text_span: следван от отопление от централен източник – 28.6%
errors.evidence: The description states that the second largest heating source for the "Общо" (Total) category is central heating with 28.6%. However, the chart shows that the 28.6% value corresponds to electricity ("Електричество"). The value for central heating ("отопление от централен източник") is 16.4%.

errors.text_span: В стълба за "Градове" най-високият сегмент е отново на дървата – 38.3%
errors.evidence: The description claims that wood ("дървата") is the largest segment in the "Градове" (Cities) category with 38.3%. According to the chart, 38.3% is the value for electricity ("Електричество"), while the value for wood is 22.8%.
The description states that the share of gas ("Газ") for the "Общо" (Total) category is 0.2%, but the chart labels this value as 0.7%.
The description states that the share of gas ("Газ") for the "Градове" (Cities) category is 0.7%, but the chart labels this value as 0.9%.

The phrase "Най-високият сегмент" (the highest segment) is ambiguous. It could mean the segment with the largest percentage value or the segment physically located at the top of the stacked bar. The description appears to use it to mean the segment with the highest value, but this is not its literal meaning and can cause confusion.
